user.title: Pick a device
user.description: Choose the device whose entities should be combined into a humidifier. Any integration works: LocalTuya, MQTT, ESPHome, Shelly, Modbus and so on.

data_description.device_id: Its entities are inspected and a mapping is proposed on the next step.

mapping.title: Confirm the mapping
mapping.description: Suggested mapping for {device}. Correct anything that looks wrong; clearing an optional field removes that feature.

data_description.power_entity: Turns the device on and off.
data_description.target_humidity_entity: Holds the humidity setpoint. Its min, max and step are inherited by the proxy.
data_description.mode_entity: Exposed as the humidifier's operating modes.
data_description.fan_speed_entity: When set, a fan entity is created. HomeKit renders it as a native fan with a speed slider.
data_description.oscillate_entity: Exposed as the fan's oscillation control. Requires a fan speed entity.
data_description.extra_entities: Mirrored as attributes of the humidifier entity, so the whole device stays readable from one place without adding HomeKit accessories.

error.oscillate_requires_fan: Oscillation needs a fan speed entity to attach to.

abort.already_configured: This device already has a Humidifier Proxy.
